blurb: A service with an `on call` handler is internal to a deployment: it has no public route, and a `system` case can only send requests through the Worker's front door. So `svc.call(…)` is refused in one. Call it at `unit` or `integration`, or drive an http route that reaches it. For the event equivalent, see `bynk.test.event_needs_in_process`.
summary: A `system`-tier case calls an `on call` service with `svc.call(…)`; an `on call` service is internal to a deployment and has no public route for a `system` case to drive, so the case drives an `http` route that reaches it, or calls it at `unit` or `integration`.
